text:
Maya P.: PR #4521 ready for review — fixes regression that caused 5xx spike on /api/generate. https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-service/pull/4521. Unit tests + staging canary passed. Urgent: please review + approve so we can canary to prod. Rollback plan included in PR description.
Jordan L.: quick q — does this change any config or require a rollout window?
Maya P.: no migrations, just tightening backpressure in request router and a guard for malformed payloads. MAX_CONCURRENCY default unchanged. Should be safe for a quick canary.
Samir G.: small request — add a one-line entry to CHANGES.md saying "fix: prevent 5xx on /api/generate under load" and squash fixup commit.
Alex C.: I can review in ~10m. Ping me if you need faster.
Maya P.: thanks — added CHANGES.md and force-pushed. Staging canary link: https://staging.redwood/logs/canary-4521
deploy-bot: CI checks passed — build #9821 ✅
Jordan L.: if Alex gives LGTM I'll merge and run a 15m canary, monitor error-rate and p95 latency. @oncall please watch the alerts during canary.
Samir G.: also include a one-liner rollback command in the PR: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service -n prod`
Alex C.: LGTM. Minor nit on a comment (formatting) — non-blocking.
Maya P.: addressed the nit and pushed. Thanks Alex. Who's merging?
Jordan L.: I'll merge in ~5m if no objections and kick off canary.
Alex C.: no objections. :thumbsup:
Jordan L.: merged and started canary deploy (deploy-id: 9821-canary). Watch logs: https://logs.redwood/deploy/9821-canary
deploy-bot: Deploy started — 9821-canary. Monitoring hooks enabled.
Jordan L.: pinging oncall: please escalate immediately if error rate >1% during canary; otherwise I'll promote after 15m.
